recipes.title: Biscoff Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: vanilla pudding mix (fat-free if you can find it)

steps: Blend the base
Blend the skim milk, almond milk, protein powder and pudding mix (plus any extras for this flavour) with a hand blender until there are no clumps.
Freeze
Freeze in a Creami pint for at least 24 hours.
Spin
Spin on Lite Ice Cream. If it comes out powdery, add a splash of milk and Re-spin.
Mix in
Scoop a hole in the middle, add the Biscoff spread and crushed biscuits (save a little for the top if you like) and run Mix-In.
recipes.notes: Protein and calories for the full pint as stated in the video; carbs and fat are estimates. Use a whey–casein blend — pure whey isolate won't spin as creamy. Freezing time not included.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Oreo Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: vanilla pudding mix (fat-free if you can find it)

steps: Blend the base
Blend the skim milk, almond milk, protein powder and pudding mix (plus any extras for this flavour) with a hand blender until there are no clumps.
Freeze
Freeze in a Creami pint for at least 24 hours.
Spin
Spin on Lite Ice Cream. If it comes out powdery, add a splash of milk and Re-spin.
Mix in
Scoop a hole in the middle, add the mini Oreos (keep a couple to crush on top) and run Mix-In. Finish with a squeeze of peanut butter.
recipes.notes: Protein and calories for the full pint as stated in the video (including the peanut butter drizzle); carbs and fat are estimates. Use a whey–casein blend — pure whey isolate won't spin as creamy. Freezing time not included. Chocolate whey also works for this one.
